criteria.description: A successful verdict response guarantees that both the current-verdict fact and referenced evidence record are durable.
criteria.evidence: WP03/WP04 approved suites; exact production-path baseline in native run 32734018925 proves every reported success has committed current-verdict and evidence records.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion finalized from spec.md FR-001.

criteria.description: A submission that reaches the 10-second queue timeout or is independently forbidden by state policy returns an explicit causal refusal.
criteria.evidence: Approved WP02 queue and WP04 structured-refusal tests prove 10-second typed queue timeout plus typed invalid-transition refusal without false durability.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion finalized from spec.md FR-002.

criteria.description: Two successful concurrent submissions retain two distinct evidence records without overwrite or impersonation.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/test_review_durability_matrix.py::test_sc004_two_concurrent_processes_never_clobber_a_verdict_over_50_iterations; native run 32734018925 passed on Ubuntu, macOS, Windows.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion finalized from spec.md FR-003.

criteria.description: Human and machine-readable results distinguish durable success, explicit refusal, and intentionally non-committed operation.
criteria.evidence: Approved WP04 durability response tests, WP05 topology matrix, and WP06 real-save benchmark distinguish durable, explicit-refusal, and intentionally non-committed outcomes.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion finalized from spec.md FR-004.

criteria.description: A refused or interrupted submission leaves no orphan that prevents an identical retry from succeeding without manual repair.
criteria.evidence: Approved WP03 adoption/recovery and WP04 retry/failure-shape suites prove refused/interrupted submissions leave no orphan and identical retry succeeds.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion finalized from spec.md FR-005.

criteria.description: The current-verdict authority and referenced evidence record agree for every completed submission.
criteria.evidence: Approved WP01 production oracle plus WP03/WP04 event-to-evidence correlation/read-back tests prove successful authority pointers resolve to committed identical evidence.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion finalized from spec.md FR-006.

criteria.description: The durability contract holds across all supported mission topologies and automatic-commit modes.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/review/test_verdict_save_topologies.py and test_reject_from_in_review.py passed 20/20 across governed mission topology and automatic-commit cells.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion finalized from spec.md FR-007.

criteria.description: The concurrency acceptance test exercises the production reviewer entry point and fails when either event serialization or evidence commitment is removed.
criteria.evidence: Native run 32734018925 passed exact real-entry baseline and independent event/evidence mutants on Ubuntu, macOS, Windows; both mutants fail causally when their production protection is disabled.
criteria.notes: Acceptance criterion finalized from spec.md FR-008.
